notice.buyer.001: ℹ️ The bot does not message buyers. To send a buyer a receipt, type "receipt 12" and forward the PDF to them.
notice.undo.001: ℹ️ Only the last action can be undone right now. Type "undo". Undo for a single order is not available yet.
notice.phone.001: ⚠️ That phone number is not valid. Type 11 digits, for example: "Sara ka phone 03001234567".
notice.draft.001: ℹ️ An order is half-entered, so several orders cannot be cancelled in one message. To drop the half-entered order, type "cancel" on its own. To cancel an order, send one number per message, like "cancel 1".
